yoruba: Ẹlẹ́ṣin náà gun ẹṣin dúdú.
english_meaning: The rider rode a black horse.

yoruba: Ọmọbìnrin náà fẹ́ aṣọ funfun.
english_meaning: The girl wants white clothes.

yoruba: Agbẹ̀ náà gbé agbọn sí orí tábìlì.
english_meaning: The farmer placed the basket on the table.

yoruba: Ṣé ẹ̀fọ́ náà ti sè dáadáa?
english_meaning: Has the vegetable cooked properly?

yoruba: Ẹ fi ṣíbí kékeré rú ọbẹ̀ náà.
english_meaning: Use a small spoon to stir the soup.

yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ ẹyẹ ń fò lórí igi.
english_meaning: Many birds are flying above the tree.

yoruba: Adìẹ funfun náà wọ inú ọgbà.
english_meaning: The white chicken entered the garden.
pronunciation_focus: ẹ and ọ; nasal vowel in wọ

yoruba: Bàtà pupa yẹn tóbi jù.
english_meaning: Those red shoes are too big.

yoruba: Aṣọ dúdú náà ti gbẹ.
english_meaning: The black cloth has dried.
pronunciation_focus: ṣ and gb; ọ/ẹ vowel quality

yoruba: Ọkùnrin náà ń gé igi pẹ̀lú àdá.
english_meaning: The man is cutting wood with a cutlass.
pronunciation_focus: ọ/u; syllabic ń; gé and pẹ̀lú

yoruba: Ìyẹn ni ọkọ̀ akérò wa.
english_meaning: That is our passenger vehicle.
pronunciation_focus: ọkọ̀; mid and low tone sequence

yoruba: Ọ̀nà yìí lọ sí ilé ìfowópamọ́.
english_meaning: This road leads to the bank.

yoruba: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, dín ohun náà kù.
english_meaning: Please lower the volume.

yoruba: Mu kọ́kọ́rọ́ náà wá fún mi.
english_meaning: Bring the key to me.

yoruba: Aago ògiri náà ti dúró.
english_meaning: The wall clock has stopped.

yoruba: Wọ́n fi ẹran sínú ìkòkò ńlá.
english_meaning: They put the meat inside the large pot.

yoruba: Obìnrin náà ta ata pupa ní ọjà.
english_meaning: The woman sells red pepper at the market.

yoruba: Mo rí òṣùpá ní alẹ́ àná.
english_meaning: I saw the moon last night.

yoruba: Ọmọkùnrin náà ń kọrin ní ohùn rara.
english_meaning: The boy is singing loudly.
pronunciation_focus: ọ/u; syllabic ń; kọrin and ohùn

yoruba: Kí ló dé tí ilẹ̀ fi tutù?
english_meaning: Why is the ground cold?

yoruba: Nígbà wo ni ọkọ̀ òfurufú yóò dé?
english_meaning: When will the airplane arrive?

yoruba: Ẹ máa rìn pẹ̀lẹ́pẹ̀lẹ́ lójú ọ̀nà.
english_meaning: Walk carefully on the road.

yoruba: Àwọn ará wa dé láìsí ìṣòro.
english_meaning: Our relatives arrived without any problem.

yoruba: Ó yẹ kí a fọ ẹ̀wà náà dáadáa.
english_meaning: We should wash the beans properly.
pronunciation_focus: yẹ; fọ; ẹ̀wà; tone and vowel contrasts

yoruba: Màmá ń lọ ata fún ọbẹ̀.
english_meaning: Mother is grinding pepper for the soup.

yoruba: Ọmọ náà fi bàtà sí abẹ́ àga.
english_meaning: The child put the shoes under the chair.

yoruba: Ṣé wọ́n ti ṣètò yàrá àlejò?
english_meaning: Have they prepared the guest room?

yoruba: Ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ náà sáré kọjá ọgbà.
english_meaning: The pig ran across the garden.

yoruba: Afẹ́fẹ́ tútù ń fẹ́ láti ìlà-oòrùn.
english_meaning: A cool wind is blowing from the east.

yoruba: Ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ fi ìwé sí orí àpótí.
english_meaning: His or her friend put the book on the box.
